tools.name: list_fivetran_connectors
tools.description: List all connected Fivetran data sources. Always call this first to show which data sources are available. This makes the MCP usage visible.

tools.name: trigger_fivetran_sync
tools.description: Force a fresh data sync on a Fivetran connector before taking a metrics snapshot. Use before logging any decision to ensure the snapshot is current.

connector_id.description: The Fivetran connector ID to sync

tools.name: get_current_metrics
tools.description: Pull the current metrics snapshot from all connected Fivetran sources via BigQuery. Returns MRR, churn rate, NPS, CAC, LTV, support tickets, runway.

demo_scenario.description: Optional: load demo data instead of live data. Values: 'acmesaas', 'qwikster'

tools.name: log_decision
tools.description: Record a business decision with a full snapshot of all current Fivetran metrics at this exact moment.

tools.name: trace_causal_chain
tools.description: Given a bad outcome, trace it back to its root decision. Calculates Pearson correlation and shows the exact data that predicted the outcome.

outcome_first_observed.description: ISO date when the problem first appeared

affected_metric.description: Which metric changed (e.g. churn_rate, mrr, nps)

tools.name: check_early_warnings
tools.description: Check if current metrics match any patterns that preceded bad outcomes in the decision history. Fire alerts if patterns are detected.

tools.name: ask_decision_log
tools.description: Answer questions about the decision log. 'Why do we price this way?' 'What caused the churn spike?' 'What data existed when we made the hiring decision?'

question.description: The question to answer from the decision log
